issues.legal_issue: A tenant cannot avoid eviction under the special rent-default provision by paying or offering arrears after the notice period expires but before the eviction suit is filed.
material_facts: Rent was payable monthly and was in arrears for more than six months.
There was no dispute about the amount of rent.
The tenant did not pay the arrears within one month after receiving the landlord’s written demand.
After that month expired but before the eviction suit was filed, the tenant sent the arrears to the landlord, who refused them.
issues.conclusion: Because the conditions for eviction under section 12(3)(a) were satisfied, the tenant could not claim protection under section 12(1) by tendering rent before the suit was filed, and the court was bound to decree eviction.
issues.legal_principle: Section 12(1) provides a general restriction on recovery of possession while the tenant pays or is ready and willing to pay rent and performs the tenancy conditions; section 12(2) requires written demand and expiration of one month before suit; and section 12(3)(a) governs the specified case of monthly rent, undisputed rent, arrears of six months or more, and failure to pay within that month. Where section 12(3)(a) applies, its special provisions displace protection under section 12(1), and the word “may” in the then-applicable text required the court to decree eviction. The Court followed Bhaiya Punjalal Dhagwanddin v. Dave Bhagwat Prosad Prabhuprasad and rejected the contrary views in Mohanlal v. Maheshwari Mills Ltd. and Ambalal v. Babaldas.

rule.if: eviction_suit_for_rent_default and rent_payable_monthly and rent_amount_undisputed and arrears_at_least_six_months and tenant_failed_to_pay_within_notice_period and tenant_tendered_after_notice_period_before_suit

predicates.eviction_suit_for_rent_default: A landlord brought a suit seeking eviction because the tenant had failed to pay rent.
predicates.rent_payable_monthly: The tenant’s rent was payable by the month.
predicates.rent_amount_undisputed: The tenant and landlord did not dispute the amount of rent due.
predicates.arrears_at_least_six_months: The rent was in arrears for six months or more.
predicates.tenant_failed_to_pay_within_notice_perio: The tenant did not pay the arrears within the period allowed after the landlord’s written demand.
predicates.tenant_tendered_after_notice_period_befo: After the notice period expired and before the suit was filed, the tenant paid or offered to pay the arrears.

issues.definition: When a landlord brings a rent-default eviction suit, the rent is monthly and undisputed, arrears have lasted at least six months, the tenant fails to pay within the notice period, and the tenant tenders payment after that period but before suit, the court must decree eviction.
